messages:
Avery (on-call): ops-bot triggered: HIGH latency on /v1/generate for hosted-prod across us-east-1. 3xx-5xxs stable but p50/p95 spiked > 600ms. Pager fired at ~2133334444.
ops-bot: ALERT: service=api-gen severity=page metric=generate_latency_p95 value=612ms threshold=500ms region=us-east-1
Avery (on-call): acked. Jumping on bridge. @Priya @Kai please stand by — might need quick rollback to smaller model variant.
Priya: on it, pulling recent deploys. Not seeing any deploys in last 30m. Can you dump recent QPS and batch sizes?
Avery (on-call): qps steady ~1200, but batching average increased from 1.2 -> 3.8 over 10m. KV cache hit dropped to 18% from 65%.
Kai: that smells like a cache invalidation/eviction. Checking autoscaler and redis eviction logs.
Liam: I see a flurry of large prefix invalidations from a background job in contours-job-runner at 2133334400. Looks correlated.
Elena: flagging customer-impact: internal dashboards show degraded interactive latency; session timeouts for some users. Not wide error rate, mostly latency.
Sam (SRE): decided: emergent mitigation — reduce batch_max to 2 and enable fallback to cached-kv policy. @Avery can you toggle runtime flags for pool-3?
Avery (on-call): applying batch_max=2 on pool-3 now. Pushing change: `rdctl runtime update pool-3 --batch_max=2`.
ops-bot: DEPLOY: runtime flag update started by Avery at 2133334501
Priya: enabling kv-cache-fallback policy on routing rules for pool-3
ops-bot: CONFIG: routing change by Priya at 2133334510
Avery (on-call): latency p95 coming down to ~320ms after change. KV hit slowly climbing back up.
Kai: confirmed redis eviction rate dropped after we suspended that background job; contacting contours team to get a fix out.
Elena: customer comms: no external incident page yet. We'll wait until we have stable numbers but prepare an advisory draft.
Liam: recommended post-incident actions: 1) Lock down prefix invalidation permissions for background jobs. 2) Add quota on invalidation rate. 3) Hard SLO for KV hit ratio alerts.
Sam (SRE): agreed. Also we need an alert dedupe window — current paging fires on every host. Suggest: for generate_latency_p95 set a 5m dedupe + group by service instead of instance.
Priya: good call. Draft alert patch in staging first. Here's proposed prometheus rule snippet:
```
- alert: GenerateLatencyP95
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="api-gen"}[5m])) by (le)) > 0.5
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "api-gen p95 latency high"
```
Avery (on-call): capturing timeline + actions in the incident doc: https://redwood-internal/incs/INC-2133334444
Elena: scheduling postmortem — available slots tomorrow 10:00 and 15:00 PT. Who can make 10:00?
Kai: 10:00 works for me.
Liam: 10:00 OK.
Priya: I can do 10:00.
Sam (SRE): add me at 10:00.
Avery (on-call): booked: Postmortem meeting 10:00 PT tomorrow. Invites sent. Doc link above.
Avery (on-call): creating follow-up tickets now with owners.
ops-bot: TICKET CREATED: INC-2133334444-1 "Limit invalidation rate for background jobs" assigned to @Liam
ops-bot: TICKET CREATED: INC-2133334444-2 "Alert dedupe and group-by change for generate_latency_p95" assigned to @Sam
ops-bot: TICKET CREATED: INC-2133334444-3 "Runtime: default batch_max reduction & rollout plan" assigned to @Priya
Priya: I'll work the runtime rollout plan — want a canary in us-west then ramp. Will add rollback steps.
Sam (SRE): for alerting we should also add a noise-mitigation runbook: when p95 spikes but kv-hit < 30% then treat as degen-cache event and suppress pages to on-call for 15m while paging infra team.
Elena: also adding customer follow-up checklist: - advisory draft - affected customer list - post-incident note to CSMs. I'll own customer comms.
Avery (on-call): post-ops checklist: 1) Confirm background job fix deployed 2) Verify KV hit ratio stable > 60% for 1h 3) Run synthetic ramp tests 4) Close or escalate tickets
Kai: I've created a branch that rate-limits invalidation calls and added counters. PR: https://git.internal/repo/contours/pull/422
Liam: will coordinate with contours team for emergency patch and schedule code review. ETA for patch to prod: 3h.
Priya: devex note: we should add an observability signal for sudden drop in KV hit ratio (delta > 30% in 10m). That's probably a cheap early-warning.
Sam (SRE): will implement an SLO alert alignment: current latency SLO is 300ms p95 — we should add a secondary SLO tied to cache health so we can auto-route when cache degrades.
Elena: postmortem agenda in doc: 1) timeline 2) root cause 3) customer impact 4) action items 5) owners + due dates
Avery (on-call): immediate status: customer impact limited, mitigations in place, monitoring stable. Closing pager. Thanks team :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: service=api-gen resolved_by=Avery resolution_ts=2133334772
Avery (on-call): follow-ups recap (will paste into doc):
- INC-2133334444-1 (Liam): enforce invalidation rate limit — due 2d
- INC-2133334444-2 (Sam): alert rule dedupe + runbook — due 5d
- INC-2133334444-3 (Priya): runtime batch_max default & rollout docs — due 3d
- Customer comms (Elena): advisory + CSM outreach — due 1d
Priya: tagging the runtime change as emergency mitigated; will schedule config review to avoid unexpected perf side-effects.
Sam (SRE): after postmortem we'll add an alert-testing exercise to oncall rotation to avoid alert drift.
Elena: thanks all. I'll post final advisory after the meeting and update status page if needed.
Avery (on-call): closing thread once tickets are created and postmortem scheduled. Good job team, solid run.
Priya: one last note — consider adding a low-latency fallback model with shorter seqs in runtime for interactive flows. Filing a research spike for next sprint.
Liam: noted. I'll update the incident doc with PR link and patch ETA.
Avery (on-call): last_message: 2133334950 — adding this as final update.
